get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying desired properties through query parameters. This endpoint is useful for retrieving a list of CRM objects, such as contacts or deals, with optional filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and return a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint allows you to create standard objects in your HubSpot account, and provides documentation and examples for the process.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This endpoint allows you to move multiple objects of a specified type to the recycling bin in a single request, which can be useful for bulk data management and cleanup operations.

Create a batch of CRM objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to create multiple objects in a single request, which can be useful for efficiently importing data or synchronizing with external systems. The response will include the details of the created objects, including their IDs.

Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint allows you to specify which properties and property histories to return for each object. It supports filtering results to include only archived objects if needed.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects simultaneously by providing their updated properties. It is useful for bulk updates where changes need to be applied to several records at once.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects by their unique property values. This endpoint allows for efficient management of multiple objects in a single request, ensuring that existing objects are updated and new ones are created as needed.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to identify the contact by setting the 'idProperty' to 'email'. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to combine two objects into a single entity, retaining the primary object's ID and merging the properties and associations from the secondary object.

Search for CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to perform complex searches and retrieve objects that match the specified conditions. It is useful for finding specific records based on property values or other attributes.

get.description: Read an object identified by `objectId` in your HubSpot account. By default, `objectId` refers to the internal object ID, but you can specify a unique property using the `idProperty` query parameter. Use the `properties` query parameter to control which properties are returned in the response.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object, effectively removing it from active use while retaining the option to restore it later if needed.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type
